evals.name: single-unit-single-cluster
evals.prompt: I have a worker running in my kind-dev cluster. Bind my 'checkout' unit in space myapp-dev to that cluster so I can apply it.
evals.expected_output: Preflights cub worker list to confirm the worker exists, composes the target JSON parameters including KubeContext and KubeNamespace, cub target create with --provider kubernetes --toolchain Kubernetes/YAML referencing the worker, cub unit set-target to attach the checkout unit, and verifies via cub target get and cub unit get (TargetID populated). Hands off to cub-apply as next step. Does not run apply.

evals.name: bulk-bind-by-label
evals.prompt: All units labeled Tier=backend in myapp-staging should deploy to the staging-target we already have in the shared targets space. Set that up for all of them.
evals.expected_output: Uses cub unit set-target --space myapp-staging --where "Labels.Tier = 'backend'" targets/staging-target, confirms the bulk blast radius with the user before running, and verifies via cub unit list --where "TargetID IS NOT NULL AND Labels.Tier = 'backend'" that the count matches. Does not create a new Target (reuses existing).

evals.name: add-argo-renderer-to-existing
evals.prompt: We're switching from direct kubectl apply to Argo for our prod deploys. Add Argo output to our existing prod-target.
evals.expected_output: Uses cub target update (or recreates with multi-provider) to add ArgoCDRenderer alongside the existing Kubernetes provider, verifies the referenced Worker actually supports argocdrenderer via cub worker list-function, and notes that the switch will take effect on the next cub-apply. Does not try to migrate live Argo Applications outside of ConfigHub.
